questions.prompt: How many total individual piano keys are pressed across all pianos played by jazz musicians performing in clubs across New York City in a single year?
reasoning: There are roughly 300 jazz clubs and live music venues in New York City hosting performances nightly.
A typical jazz band plays for about 2 hours per night, with the pianist striking keys at an average rate of 3 keys per second.
3 keys per second multiplied by 7200 seconds per night yields about 21,600 key presses per venue per night.
Multiplying 21,600 by 365 days and 300 venues results in approximately 2.36 billion presses, scaled up slightly for active jam sessions and practice hours to 4.5 billion.

questions.prompt: How many total individual drops of water are contained within all standard indoor residential bathtub fills completed across households in Canada in a single year?
reasoning: Canada has approximately 15 million households, and assume roughly half take baths occasionally, averaging about 30 baths per household per year, totaling 225 million baths annually.
A standard bathtub holds about 150 litres of water per fill.
Each litre of water contains approximately 20,000 individual drops.
Multiplying 225 million baths by 150 litres and then by 20,000 drops per litre gives a total of 675 trillion drops.

questions.prompt: How many total individual bristles are tufted into all standard manual toothbrushes manufactured by factories in Germany in a single year?
reasoning: German toothbrush manufacturing plants produce roughly 40 million finished toothbrushes annually for domestic use and export.
A standard manual toothbrush contains approximately 40 tufts of nylon filaments.
Each tuft consists of roughly 20 individual fine nylon bristles.
Multiplying 40 million toothbrushes by 40 tufts and 20 bristles per tuft yields a total of 32 billion bristles.
